payload.title: AI Builders Daily · 2026-06-09
payload.summary:
**Benchmarks just got meaner**: **FrontierCode** lands with maintainer-grade rubrics and a brutal 13.8% on FC Diamond, calling half of **SWE-Bench** “unmergeable slop”; **Apple developers get a new routing stack** as **Claude** plugs into the Foundation Models framework for heavier reasoning and tool use; the builder chatter is all about interfaces and control, from **NotebookLM** expanding beyond source files to **Codex** phone workflows, nested loops, and the stubborn reality that context still beats raw intelligence.

**基准开始下狠手了**：**FrontierCode** 这次不看会不会跑通测试，直接盯上代码能不能真进主干，连 **SWE-Bench** 都被点名一半是“合不进去的糊弄活”；**Apple** 这边也有实打实的新东西，**Claude** 接进 Foundation Models，轻任务留在端侧，复杂推理再往上接；另一条线也很热闹，大家都在聊工具怎么真正顺手，从 **NotebookLM** 往外扩检索、**Codex** 上手机桌面，到一句老实话反复被验证：模型再强，没上下文还是容易跑偏。

sections.headline: **Onyx** pitches AI agents that watch other AI agents for enterprise security · **Onyx** 在卖一种企业安全方案：用 AI 盯 AI
sections.body:
**No Priors** talks with **Onyx Security** CEO **Maxim Bar Kogan** about why enterprise security has shifted from worrying about employees pasting data into chatbots to worrying about autonomous agents taking real actions. His argument is blunt: companies cannot stop agent adoption now, so they need a control layer that can inspect whether an agent action is legitimate before it causes outages, leaks code or tokens, or makes destructive infrastructure changes. He frames **AutoGPT** as the early spark, then says reasoning models and coding agents like **Claude Code** turned that old thought experiment into a real deployment problem.

The product pitch is an “AI control plane” trained on agent behavior, built to oversee other agents at machine speed because human-in-the-loop review does not scale when action volume grows 100x or 1000x. Kogan says more than half of agent usage in a typical enterprise already comes from autonomous coding agents and assistants, with low-code automations close behind and internally built first-party agents still rare. He also argues traditional controls like identity, endpoint, and API security break down when companies deliberately give coding agents broad permissions so they can finish work unattended.

**No Priors** 这期找来 **Onyx Security** CEO **Maxim Bar Kogan**，主题很直接：企业安全的焦点，已经从“员工会不会把数据贴进聊天机器人”，变成“自主代理会不会真的把事做砸”。他的核心判断也很硬：企业现在拦不住代理落地，那就只能补一层控制面，去判断这些代理动作到底合不合理，避免宕机、代码和 token 泄露，或者莫名其妙把数据库删了重建。他把 **AutoGPT** 说成当年的引爆点，而真正把问题推到企业面前的，是后来的推理模型和 **Claude Code** 这类编码代理。

产品思路叫“AI control plane”：训练模型去看代理怎么行动，再用这些模型反过来盯别的代理，因为一旦动作量涨到 100 倍、1000 倍，人肉审核根本扛不住。Kogan 还给了一个挺具体的部署切面：普通大企业里，超过一半的代理使用已经是自主编码代理和助手；低代码自动化紧随其后；真正自己从头搭的一方代理还很少。他的另一个判断也很关键：当企业为了省事，把大权限直接交给编码代理时，传统的身份、终端、API 安全那套就没那么管用了。

sections.headline: **Claude** joins Apple’s Foundation Models stack for Swift apps · **Claude** 接进苹果 Foundation Models，直接进 Swift 工作流
sections.body:
**Anthropic** says **Claude** is getting support in Apple’s **Foundation Models** framework through a new Swift package. The pitch is a split-brain app architecture: let Apple’s on-device models handle fast local work like summarization or extraction, then route harder requests such as multi-step reasoning, code generation, web search, and data-analysis code execution to **Claude**. Because the framework can produce typed Swift values through guided generation, developers can pass structured inputs instead of raw free-form prompts and stream responses back into the same **SwiftUI** view.

The package is slated to be available the next day across **iOS 27**, **iPadOS 27**, **macOS 27**, **visionOS 27**, and **watchOS 27**. The broader message is that Apple developers do not need to choose between local intelligence and cloud reasoning anymore. They can keep lightweight interactions on-device, then hand off to **Claude** only when a task gets complex.

**Anthropic** 这篇博客讲得很清楚：他们给苹果 **Foundation Models** 框架接了一个新的 Swift 包，让 **Claude** 能直接进入 Apple 开发者现成的调用链。思路不是替代端侧模型，而是分工更细：本地模型负责摘要、抽取这类轻活；碰到多步推理、代码生成、联网搜索、数据分析这类重任务，再把请求交给 **Claude**。因为框架本身能吐出类型化的 Swift 值，开发者不用拿一坨原始用户输入硬塞给模型，结构会干净很多，回流到 **SwiftUI** 视图也顺。

发布时间点也卡得很近，文中写的是次日可用，覆盖 **iOS 27**、**iPadOS 27**、**macOS 27**、**visionOS 27** 和 **watchOS 27**。说白了，这不是“本地还是云端”二选一，而是把两边拼成一个连续体验：简单任务留在设备上，真复杂了再抬手交给 **Claude**。

sections.headline: **FrontierCode** calls time on test-passing slop / **FrontierCode** 开始清算“测试过了就算赢”的糊弄代码
sections.body:
It's finally out!!! @METR_Evals found that more than half of SWEBench results is unmergeable slop.  FrontierCode represents over 1000+ hours of maintainer validated software engineering work most frontier models cannot yet solve, much less solve with high quality.

Cog had IOI Gold medalists and top code maintainers Look At The Data — FrontierCode includes 3000+ rubrics covering code quality and anticheat reward hacking plaguing other benchmarks. 

FC Diamond is so hard that Opus 4.8 scores 13.8%.

Three eras of AI coding : Three eras of benchmarks

2021 • Autocomplete : HumanEval
2023 • Passing Tests: SWEBench, TerminalBench
2026 • Maintainable Code: FrontierCode

to me the most beautiful chart when I requested a special historical run into all extant old models, the data was finding that the easiest third of FC tasks (in FC Extended) were rapidlly and suddenly solved over late 2025 - Opus almost doubled from a 41% pass rate to 74% in 4 months. 

This describes the "WTF happened in Dec 2025" vibe shift that a lot of folks from @dhh to @karpathy have called out: it is the difference between getting 95% success in 2 rerolls vs 6, making it finally feasible to go up the next layer of abstraction in agentic coding, eg @GeoffreyHuntley's ralph loops or @bcherny's /goals or  @steipete's "loops that prompt your agents" without fearing too much that things go off the rails.

My guess: as AI accelerates from here, each FrontierCode tier will saturate in sequence, hopefully ~annually. I've already asked the team to prepare FrontierCode 2027....

The old mountains will be destroyed. Their rubble becomes regolith. And from that regolith, the next model forest grows. Circle of life.

终于发出来了！！！@METR_Evals 发现，**SWE-Bench** 里超过一半的结果其实都是根本合不进主干的糊弄活。**FrontierCode** 代表了 1000 多小时、由维护者验证过的软件工程工作，而现在的大多数前沿模型不仅解不出来，更别说高质量地解出来。

Cog 找来了 IOI 金牌选手和顶级代码维护者，去认真看数据。**FrontierCode** 里有 3000 多条 rubric，专门盯代码质量和其他基准里常见的反作弊、奖励黑客问题。

FC Diamond 难到什么程度？**Opus 4.8** 只有 13.8%。

AI 编码的三个时代，对应三种基准：

2021 • 自动补全：**HumanEval**
2023 • 通过测试：**SWE-Bench**、**TerminalBench**
2026 • 可维护代码：**FrontierCode**

对我来说，最漂亮的一张图，是我让团队把现存的老模型也做了一次历史回跑之后看到的：FC 任务里最简单的三分之一（在 FC Extended 中）在 2025 年底突然被快速攻下，**Opus** 4 个月里通过率几乎翻倍，从 41% 涨到 74%。

这基本就是很多人从 @dhh 到 @karpathy 都在说的那个“2025 年 12 月到底发生了什么”的气氛变化：差别在于，你要达到 95% 成功率，究竟是重掷 2 次还是 6 次。这个差别终于让代理式编码能往上一层抽象，比如 @GeoffreyHuntley 的 ralph loops、@bcherny 的 /goals，或者 @steipete 说的“用循环去提示你的代理”，而不用老担心事情彻底失控。

我的猜测是：随着 AI 继续加速，**FrontierCode** 的每一层大概会按顺序被吃掉，希望差不多是一年一层。我已经让团队开始准备 **FrontierCode 2027** 了……

旧山会被推平。碎石会变成风化层。下一片模型森林，就从这层土里长出来。循环往复。

sections.headline: Raw intelligence is not enough without context / 没上下文，光有智力堆再高也不够用
sections.body:
There’s no amount of intelligence that can get packed into AI models that replaces the need for context. For any sufficiently general purpose AI, you will always have to guide it in the direction you want as it has an infinite range of directions it can go in.

As long as the same model is used by a lawyer, an engineer, a financial analyst, or a healthcare professional, and as long as you’re trying to do anything uniquely differentiated or specific, then instructions, domain context, and proprietary data will always need to get into the context window for the model to be useful.

This is partly why AI automation doesn’t come for free, and why there’s still a wide spectrum of who’s getting the largest gains from AI and who’s not. You have to put in real work, and you get real value on the other end.

This is one of the advantages that applied AI will also have in the market. Any layer of abstraction above just the raw intelligence that can meaningfully get you off to the races faster will likely continue to be valuable.

不管往 AI 模型里塞多少智力，都替代不了上下文。只要是足够通用的 AI，你就始终得把它往你要的方向引，因为它天然可以朝无限多的方向跑。

只要同一个模型还在同时服务律师、工程师、金融分析师和医疗从业者，只要你要做的事带有明确的差异化或专业性，那说明、领域上下文和私有数据，就始终得进到模型的上下文窗口里，它才会真的有用。

这也是为什么 AI 自动化不是白送的，为什么有人从 AI 里拿到的收益很大，有人却没那么明显。你得真下功夫，最后才能换来真价值。

这也是应用层 AI 在市场上的一个优势。任何能在“原始智力”之上再加一层抽象、并且能明显帮你更快起跑的东西，后面大概率都还会有价值。

sections.headline: A jab at “thesis-driven” VC theater / 顺手吐槽了一把“论文式投资”这套表演
sections.body:
The funniest texts are from founders who meet “thesis driven” GPs hoping they’ll understand EXACTLY what they are building.. 

And then realize the thesis was written and built by an associate (or, worse an intern). 

Don’t always read what the VC writes on the internet - yes, that includes me too (although I can guarantee I don’t have an associate, intern, EA or ghostwriter) 😆

最好笑的短信，往往来自那些去见“thesis driven” GP 的创始人。他们本来以为对方会**完全**理解自己在做什么……

然后才发现，那套 thesis 是个 associate 写的，甚至更惨，可能是 intern 写的。

所以别什么 VC 在网上写的都信，没错，也包括我自己（不过我可以保证，我没有 associate、intern、EA 或 ghostwriter）😆
